operational.activation: Reaction — when another creature you can perceive within range and line of effect begins casting a spell, after its casting costs and cadence are committed but before its effect resolves

operational.resolution: make a spellcasting-ability check using the actual ability for the class through which you cast Counterspell, adding PB once, against DC 10 + twice the triggering spell's actual rank (rank 0 contributes 0). operational.effect: Success negates the selected pending spell after its costs were committed; failure lets it continue. A surviving cast later resolves its effect and outcome-dependent hooks. Negation gives no refund, no successful-effect trigger and no restoration of old concentration. Counterspell is itself a spell and can be countered. Resolve nested counters last-in, first-out; if a counter is negated, the earlier pending spell resumes without paying or casting again. Resuming a parent never rewrites the later nested cast's Refrain/Dissonance history.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic success against lower ranks and no generic upcast.
operational.limitations: One attempt per creature against a particular pending cast, shared across ordinary, Wizard, Mage and other same-named Counterspell sources. Attempting does not reveal spell identity/rank; never treat an unassigned rank as 0 or estimate it from RP. Ready opens its cast-interruption window at preparation, not release. Countering is not whole-Action/turn hard denial and does not spend that ledger.
